title: Can LLMs Write Faithfully? An Agent-Based Evaluation of LLM-generated Islamic Content
reasoning: The study evaluates LLMs on generating Islamic religious content, specifically focusing on theological accuracy, citation integrity for scripture (Qur'an and Hadith), and appropriate religious tone across five domains of Islamic knowledge: Jurisprudence, Exegesis, Hadith Sciences, Theology, and Spiritual Conduct.
